preconditions.description: The number of strings in each sequence is between 1 and 20, inclusive.
Each string in the sequence s is between 1 and 10 characters long.
Each string in the sequence t is between 1 and 10 characters long.
The number of queries is between 1 and 2020, inclusive.
Each year in the queries is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output[i] == concat(s[(i-1) % n], t[(i-1) % m]) for i in range(1, q+1)
postconditions.description: The output for each year is the concatenation of the next two strings from the sequences s and t, wrapping around if necessary.

invariants.description: The sequences s and t have exactly n and m strings, respectively.

invariants.expression: all(len(s_i) <= 10 for s_i in s) and all(len(t_i) <= 10 for t_i in t)
invariants.description: Each string in s and t is at most 10 characters long.
